concerns.text: The request trace generation (FR-011) uses Cluster IDs derived from community detection on the *Proxy Graph*, and the Topological Lookahead scheduling policy (User Story 4) also uses the same Proxy Graph for pre‑fetch decisions. This creates a circular validation: the workload is constructed to be correlated with the very signal the policy exploits, so performance gains cannot be shown to be independent of the graph construction. The validation target (latency reduction) is therefore not independent of a predictor (the Proxy Graph), violating the requirement for an unbiased evaluation.
